items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 36:1
items.html: The HBD of the Sealed Brain is not like the HBD of Aba and Ima or of ZA, where the Daat decides between Hochma and Bina in the middle, because the Bina of the Sealed Brain came out of the head, as is known. Rather, the aspect of the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK of Tzelem included in it is called HBD: the MEM is called Hochma, the LAMED is called Bina, and the TZADIK is called Daat, as the Rav wrote above, Part 1, Page 76, Item 139. And although the Sealed Brain is only the TZADIK of Tzelem, nevertheless all three aspects of Tzelem are included in it, as above, Page 312, Item 39 — for the Galgalta is included in all three aspects of Tzelem, and likewise the Avir is included in all three, and likewise the Sealed Brain; see there. (Page 372, Item 162).
